name: Prompt Agents — dynamic gateway
summary: Foundry Prompt Agent routed through an APIM connection that resolves models via runtime discovery.
description: `project.agents.create_version(..., PromptAgentDefinition(model='{dynamic-connection}/{deployment}', ...))` creates a v2 Prompt Agent whose model is validated through an AI Gateway `modelDiscovery` endpoint. Invoking it through the Responses API proves users can run Prompt Agents with dynamically discovered APIM deployments.
notes:
Verified end-to-end via `PromptAgentDefinition(model='{dynamic-connection}/{deployment}')` and `aoai.responses.create(..., extra_body={'agent_reference': ...})`. See `test.py`.

Requires `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_DYNAMIC` to point at an `ApiManagement` connection with dynamic model discovery enabled.
